<MethodEndpoint
  method={"put"}
  path={"/products/{sku}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Registers the SKU as a product (201) or, when it is already
registered, replaces its description (200). A product must be
registered before it can be classified or dimensioned. Repeating the
request with the same description returns 200 and changes nothing.
